decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings are core, durable components with dedicated pages and remain integral to the system.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's direction and gained its own page in 2019.
As the flagship designer drainage line, it aligns with the firm's focus and is unlikely to be dropped.
Integrated-slope shower elements fit the low-profile trend but had only mentions, giving a moderate drop risk.
Backflow-protected basement drains address safety and regulatory needs and were promoted on the home page.
Air-admittance valves are ancillary to drainage and lacked dedicated pages, giving a higher but still limited drop probability.
